title: Okay
text: Okay. I'm not a gamer, I just spend a lot of time in my computer chair reading and writing and hoped this chair would be a comfortable chair for me. The arms are a little too short. (And I am not tall.) The foot rest feels very flimsy and cuts off at my ankles. (And I'm not tall.) The material is fine-- a little cheap looking, but comfortable and holds up well. I don't find this chair significantly better than a regular office chair, to be honest.

product_metadata.title: IWMH Gaming Chair, Racing Ergonomic Office Computer Chair with Footrest, High Back Reclining Desk Chair, Adjustable Leather Gamer Chair with Headrest and Lumbar Support, Blue
features: 【ERGONOMIC DESIGN】This large and high gaming chair is equipped with a headrest and lumbar support,providing a comfortable and strong support for your neck and lumbar. The thickened and wider seat cushion brings you more comfortable sitting experience. Combining with the maximum tilt angle of 135 degrees, its adjustable seat and armrest height will meet your individual needs.

【FOLDING FOOTREST】This gaming chair is equipped with a foldable footrest, convenient, practical and space-efficient. When you are tired of working and studying, you can pull out the footrest underneath the chair and lie back for a moment. If you don't need it, you can simply push it away with a gentle push. It is quite suitable for your work, rest, reading and play.

【HIGH QUALITY MATERIALS】This racing chair is novel in design and made of high quality materials. Its leather surface feels comfortable, breathable and is easy to clean. The seat cushion padded with high density sponge is durable and not easily deformed. 360 degree swivel nylon castors are stable and flexible, thus protecting your floor from friction with little noise.

【STURDY & DURABLE】The maximum bearing load of this gaming chair can reach 300lbs. Its structure is scientifically designed for strong load-bearing capacity, and the five-star metal tray and high-quality gas rod will make the chair even more sturdy and durable.

【QUALITY SERVICE】We have a professional customer service team to solve your problems in the process of purchase or use in a timely manner, committed to providing you with a quality shopping experience.
